items.summary: Recommendation: keep SearchWoot private and external outreach unsent. Official Woot documentation confirms API access mechanics but not public or commercial reuse rights; all four launch-readiness tasks remain open. Smallest next step: complete the consolidated rights, data-flow, consent, vendor, retention, and incident evidence bundle, then obtain human-counsel review before any owner-authorized outreach.

Legal risk disposition: blocked for public beta or full launch of the gated product; conditional for ordinary reversible fleet growth; counsel_required for upstream data rights, jurisdiction-specific privacy treatment, vendor/DPA obligations, and future affiliate or advertising use. Exact decision: keep the product private and external outreach unsent. Evidence: official API documentation establishes access mechanics but not rights to store, transform, cache, display, retain historical derivatives, send alerts, use images, trademarks, or prices, and current public terms point against the proposed commercial/public use. Compliance is a technical baseline only: 35 pass, 14 fail, and 10 unknown, with open banner, consent, analytics, privacy, and terms findings. Incomplete telemetry alone does not block ordinary reversible growth. Revenue remains limited to 2026-09-21 aggregate commission of $4.92 and is not site-attributable; ROI and margin remain unknown.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active: 0 of 4 legal tasks closed; all four remain open. No task is closed because current evidence is partial. Open tasks are source rights, alert-data flow and retention, GA4 consent/configuration, and logs/vendors/incident handling. Next evidence action: attach one consolidated read-only evidence bundle and field-level rights matrix covering provenance, permitted storage/display/alerts, freshness, correction, takedown, identifiers, retention, deletion, access, notification consent, unsubscribe behavior, GA4 settings, log fields, vendor/DPA coverage, and incident/request procedures. Do not send outreach, change the private gate, enable tracking, or expand monetization.

Data-use dispositions: Woot API deal and price-history data = counsel_required and launch-blocked; missing written permission or API agreement, field-level provenance and rights, caching/display/alert terms, attribution, freshness, correction, takedown, trademark/image/price limits, and affiliate/advertising terms. Smallest next action: complete the field-level rights matrix and route the unsent permission package for human-counsel review. User alert rules and sync results = evidence_needed; missing data inventory, identifiers, retention, deletion, correction, access, processor terms, notification consent, and unsubscribe behavior. Smallest next action: produce the repository and deployed data-flow and retention table. GA4 analytics = evidence_needed; missing deployed consent and withdrawal behavior, GA4 property/data-sharing settings, retention settings, and jurisdictional review. Smallest next action: capture existing consent and GA4 configuration without enabling tracking. Operational logs and Cloudflare hosting data = evidence_needed; missing log-field inventory, retention/access controls, vendor terms or DPA review, and incident/request procedures. Smallest next action: produce a read-only operator/vendor inventory and identify counsel-required gaps.
